'''Vrain''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the rank as [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He was head of [[Imperial Conquest Consolidation Corps]] used to quell uprisings on newly conquered [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="BTR" />
